goal: Modernized root USB OTG enabler app with high-SDK support (API 35/37) and universal multi-strategy OTG kernel sysfs/SoC driver engine
decisions_made: Targeting modern Android SDK (minSdk 26, targetSdk 37, compileSdk 37) to eliminate 'SDK version too low' install errors on modern devices

Multi-strategy root engine covering Transsion/Infinix/Tecno (/sys/devices/platform/tran_battery/OTG_CTL), MediaTek power_supply/usb/otg_switch, dual_role_usb DFP mode, modern usb_role host mode, Type-C port manager (TCPM/UCSI), Qualcomm/DWC3/Chipidea host registers, OEM system properties (persist.sys.oem.otg_support), and dynamic sysfs node auto-discovery
Release otg-enabler-v1 successfully compiled and published via GitHub Actions run 41219902728
Release assets app-otg-enabler-v1.apk, release.json, and forgebuild-manifest.json verified live with valid download URLs and checksums

v2: Single safe write helper (RootCommander.safeWriteSysfs/Prop/Setting) uses `tee` so kernel write() errno (EOPNOTSUPP/EINVAL/EACCES) is always captured, waits 200ms, and verifies readback with bracketed `[host] device` active-token parsing

v2: Symlink-aware OtgScanner traverses /sys/class/{usb_role,typec,dual_role_usb,power_supply,regulator,extcon}, /sys/devices/platform, and /sys/kernel/debug, completely excludes dummy_udc, classifies read-only nodes as `info only` without echo buttons, and caches via Engine CacheFirstStore

v2: Ordered apply feeds scanner results into role switch -> Type-C/TCPC -> MTK charger/regulator VBUS boost, captures before/after filtered dmesg diff, polls /sys/bus/usb/devices ignoring 1d6b root hubs, and reports honest VERIFIED / PARTIAL / FAILED states
v2: Disable restores only recorded changed values (never touches unverified read-only extcon0/state); SELinux permissive and legacy OEM tweaks are opt-in toggles off by default

v2: Added Copy diagnostics export + SafeSave SAF file export + per-dialog ScreenSecurity + JUnit4 unit tests (junit:junit:4.13.2 testImplementation only, zero APK size impact, wired to run before assembleRelease)
